## Easy Breakfast Steak Tacos


Tender steak, sunny-side-up eggs, and fresh toppings come together in these easy breakfast tacos for a hearty, flavorful start to the day.


---


Cook Time:


25 minutes


mins


Makes


6


[Print Recipe](https://vitalfarms.com/wprm_print/easy-breakfast-steak-tacos)[Pin Recipe](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/create/bookmarklet/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2Feasy-breakfast-steak-tacos%2F&media=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F09%2FInstacart-Recipes-Breakfast-Steak-Tacos-Cover-Image.jpg&description=Easy+Breakfast+Steak+Tacos&is_video=false)


### Ingredients


- 1


pound


skirt steak


- 1


tablespoon


steak seasoning


- 2


tablespoons


olive oil


- 6


flour tortillas


- 6


Vital Farms eggs


- 1/2


small red onion,


thinly sliced


- 1/4


cup


fresh cilantro,


roughly chopped


- 4


radishes,


thinly sliced


- 1/2


cup


cotija cheese,


crumbled


- 3/4


cup


salsa verde


### Instructions


- Pat the skirt steak dry and season generously with steak seasoning.


- Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Add the steak and cook for about 3–4 minutes per side, or until browned and medium doneness is achieved. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes. Thinly slice against the grain.


- While the steak rests, warm the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side.


- Reduce the heat to medium, add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil, and fry the eggs sunny-side up, working in batches as needed, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.


- Divide the sliced steak among the tortillas and top each with a fried egg. Finish with red onion, radishes, cilantro, cotija cheese, and salsa verde. Serve immediately.
